headline: Nasdaq-Listed Firm Considers $450M Bitcoin Sale Amid Security Concerns
summary: Next Technology Holding authorized potential sales or loans against its 5,833 Bitcoin holdings, citing exchange security risks related to a Binance hack and quantum computing fears.
why: Large corporate holdings of digital assets can create balance sheet volatility when firms decide to liquidate or hedge their crypto exposure.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Potential liquidation of $450 million in Bitcoin by a corporate holder.
